content:
rebecca: Opening PR to add a short 'proxy chaining' section for semi-airgapped private installs. Purpose: show a minimal proxy-env snippet for the node agent + a simple troubleshooting bullet about double-SNAT. Need quick wording review and confirm we don't leak vendor details.

noah: Skimming now. Two asks: 1) can the SDK example use ENV placeholders rather than concrete URLs? 2) add a short matrix row saying when to prefer HTTP CONNECT vs SOCKS for vendor CLI traffic.

rebecca: Done. SDK snippet uses placeholders (REDWOOD_KMS_URL, PROXY_HOST). Added a 1-row decision matrix: CONNECT for TLS passthrough, SOCKS for interactive CLI that needs DNS resolution at client side.

zara: For the proxy chain example, add a note about preserve-host header implications for mutual-TLS to KMS endpoints. Also prefer recommending mutual-TLS pinning at the proxy when possible.

infra-ops: Confirm mgmt-subnet approach remains recommended. Quick note: when chaining proxies in a VPC, watch for SNAT happening at both proxy and NAT gateway; include a troubleshooting step to check source IP on HSM logs. Also: we prefer examples that call out ephemeral credentials rather than long-lived tokens.

rebecca: I added the SNAT troubleshooting step and swapped token examples to env var placeholders. Kept the nftables snippet minimal and added a one-line about iptables-nft compatibility.

docs-ci-bot: Linkcheck: no broken links. Lint: 1 heading-level warning.

noah: Left tiny grammar nit on the CONNECT vs SOCKS table; otherwise LGTM.

zara: +1 from security side for the mTLS pinning callout.

rebecca: Great — will merge after CI warning fixed. Plan to post a short note in #support linking the new section once merged.

rebecca: Pushed heading fix and merged. Posting to #support shortly.
